يستدرجوا (form X)
# يَسْتَدْرِجُوا (yastadrijū) /jas.tad.ri.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# يُسْتَدْرَجُوا (yustadrajū) /jus.tad.ra.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
